# jumpcloud_users (Data Source)

Lists JumpCloud users, optionally filtered by exact field values. To look up one user, filter by `email` and use `one(data.jumpcloud_users.<name>.users)`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_users" "engineering" {
  filter = {
    department = "Engineering"
    state      = "ACTIVATED"
  }
}

locals {
  engineer_emails = [for user in data.jumpcloud_users.engineering.users : user.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Map of String) Exact, case-sensitive matches on JumpCloud user fields, combined with AND, for example `{ department = "Engineering" }`. Keys use the JumpCloud API field names, such as `department`, `jobTitle`, `state`, or `email`. Omit to list every user.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `attributes` (Map of String) Custom attributes, keyed by name.
- `department` (String) Department.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `job_title` (String) Job title.
- `state` (String) Account state, such as `ACTIVATED`, `STAGED`, or `SUSPENDED`.
- `username` (String) Username.
